name: unslop-plus
description: Anti-slop engine and profile router for software development workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Anti-slop engine and profile router for software development workflows.
interface.longDescription: Asset Marketplace-owned Unslop+ package. Use $unslop-profiles to discover, read, and apply matching consumer-owned or generic operational profiles during work and review. Use $unslop-engine to develop, revise, validate, or retire profiles from recurring evidence with consumer review.
defaultPrompt: Use $unslop-profiles to find and apply a matching operational profile when one fits, or $unslop-engine to propose profile lifecycle changes from recurring evidence.
